connector.name: Crawlora MCP
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP: 795 structured web-data tools for search, maps, commerce, social, gaming & finance.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.crawlora.net over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace net.crawlora, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
